description.value:
Effect called shots delivered at melee range against an off-guard or flanked target deal an extra 1d4 damage

Point blank is where this weapon is happiest.

cinderfall.incomplete: extra damage on melee-range Called Shots vs. off-guard/ flanked targets. (Called Shot dependency). This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This card depends on (upgrades, extends, or is gated behind) another Ironsight card in this same package that itself ships rules: [] -- if the parent has nothing real to build on, the child has nothing real to extend either.
